claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: NVP-AUY922 is a potent resorcinylic isoxazole HSP90 inhibitor that kills cells at low nanomolar concentrations by inhibiting HSP90, leading to degradation of client oncoproteins and apoptosis; at 2.5 uM (well above its GI50) it should produce broad, potent antiproliferative and cytotoxic killing across most cancer cell lines.
